notes.title: Shadows of Wyrmwood is Ready for Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Next Fest here we come![/h1]

Adventurers, the time has come! Shadows of Wyrmwood is launching into Steam Next Fest, bringing new features, balance updates, and bug fixes to enhance your journey.

[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Events[/h3]Random events now appear throughout your adventure. Some will aid you, while others will test your resolve. Be prepared for anything.
[*][h3]Blacksmiths[/h3]Before each dragon battle, a blacksmith appears. Choose one:
[list]
[*] Upgrade your gear
[*] Shop his wares
[*] Duel him for more loot
[/list]
[*][h3]Balance Updates[/h3]
Spells and enemies have been tuned for a more balanced and challenging experience.
[*][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Various small fixes to improve gameplay smoothness and stability.
[/list]
[h2]The journey through Wyrmwood awaits. Join us in Next Fest and experience the adventure firsthand![/h2]

notes.title: Massive Update! 1/24
notes.content:
[h1]Big Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Tailored Loot:[/b] Equipment is more likely to have a stat that you want 
[*][b]Reduced Healing:[/b] Enemy healing was way higher than it should be, it has been lowered
[*][b]Enemy Difficulty:[/b] Enemy power level and health has been reduced at lower difficulty levels
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Keybinds:[/b] You can now use 1-4 to cast abilities and space to end turn, optional visual indicators
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Buffs/Debuffs:[/b] some displays were incorrect
[*][b]Tutorial Saving:[/b] tutorials now save correctly
[*][b]Retry:[/b] retry at a ? node now correctly restarts combat
[/list]

Let us know what you think in the comments, discussion boards or on our Discord!
